title: Release dates for held payments
subject: Visigoth Bank, an invented retail bank
source: the delivery plan agreed on 12 Feb, and what each owner said this week

records.title: Risk rules expose a release date for every held payment
records.basis: Shipped 19 Feb. Confirmed in the staging data.

records.title: Release date shown in the app on the held payment
records.basis: Mara, Tuesday: design signed off, build is in review.

records.title: Support agents can see the same release date
records.basis: Checked the support console build notes on Wednesday.

records.title: Platform passes the load test at twice peak
records.basis: Cards Platform, last Thursday: environment booked for 9 to 13 Mar.

records.title: Borrow the Payments team's environment for three days
records.cost: Payments lose three days of their own testing. Their release moves by about a week.
records.summary: Payments have an identical environment that is free from 11 to 13 March if they move one of their own runs.

records.title: Launch to 10% of accounts before the full load test
records.cost: A partial launch on an untested path. Risk Review would need to accept a test at normal peak only.
records.summary: At 10% the extra load is far inside what was tested last year, but the new counter path itself is untested under pressure.

records.title: Accept the new date
records.cost: Nine more days of customers with no release date. About 30 more held-payment tickets at the current rate.
records.summary: Do nothing and tell the steering group.

records.title: Launch to all new business accounts
records.basis: Follows from M-2, M-3 and M-4.
